title: War and Peace
synopsis: Russia, 1805. Drawing rooms and battlefields, both crowded. You are Pierre, an awkward heir who has, somehow, just inherited the largest fortune in the empire.

nodes.text: Glittering nonsense. You speak Napoleon's name too warmly.

choices.consequence: “Be honest” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Spirit.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Civil.

nodes.text: You inherit everything. Strangers smile at you now.

choices.consequence: “Take stock” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Wise.
You commit to “Throw a party.” The story records the instinct as “Honest” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Helene's family arranges. You drift into it.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Wise.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Path.

nodes.text: Your friend leaves for war. He is, in salons, suffocating.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Toast him.” The story records the instinct as “Friend” and carries it forward.
There is no taking “Argue with him” back. Honest shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Andrei watches the sky above the field. The campaign collapses.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honor.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Patient.

nodes.text: A lodge. A teacher. You begin to read.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Path.
“Take it lightly” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honest.

nodes.text: She, sixteen, dances with Andrei. The world tilts for him.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honor.
There is no taking “Be quiet” back. Honest shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Helene's brother schemes for Natasha. He is, plainly, a cad.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Honor—follows you into whatever comes next.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Brave.

nodes.text: A field of cannon and smoke. You wander into it as an observer.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honor.
“Run” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honest.

nodes.text: Fires across the city. The French enter. You stay.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Try to assassinate Napoleon.” The story records the instinct as “Honest” and carries it forward.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Care—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: You are taken. Platon Karataev becomes, oddly, your teacher.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Listen to Platon” back. Wise shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
“Plan escape” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Spirit.

nodes.text: Platon dies on the road. The French retreat is slow.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Honor—follows you into whatever comes next.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Survive.

nodes.text: Russian cossacks. Soup. Sleep on straw.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Eat slowly.” The story records the instinct as “Honest” and carries it forward.
You commit to “Sleep.” The story records the instinct as “Honest” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: He is found. He is, dying, kinder than he was.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Honor—follows you into whatever comes next.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honor.

nodes.text: She dies, probably by her own carelessness with medicine.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Mourn correctly.” The story records the instinct as “Society” and carries it forward.
There is no taking “Be honest with yourself” back. Truth shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: She nursed Andrei. She is older. You speak as adults.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Path—follows you into whatever comes next.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Patient.

nodes.text: You write her a letter. The answer comes quickly.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honor.
You commit to “Be flippant.” The story records the instinct as “Foolish” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Nikolai marries Marya. The two estates merge.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Family—follows you into whatever comes next.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Honest—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Children. Quiet rooms. A book in your hand at dinner.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honor.
You commit to “Be a distracted one.” The story records the instinct as “Honest” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: You decide, slowly, that history is the work of millions and not Napoleons.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Write it down.” The story records the instinct as “Path” and carries it forward.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honest.

nodes.text: You stop trying to find one big answer. You find many small ones, with Natasha.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Quiet.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Spirit.
Some endings reveal themselves last.

nodes.text: You live forty quiet years with Natasha. The estate is, by your death, generous to its people. Your children write a small book about you. The book is, mostly, recipes.
You write a long, kind essay on the way history actually happens. It is, by your grandchildren's time, a textbook in one Russian university.
You live to see another war from a chair by a window. You have, by then, learned not to be surprised. You take Natasha's hand and ask her, again, to read to you.
